task:
Review this app's existing Superwall setup end to end. DO NOT modify any files.
{{skill}}
Produce a concise markdown report with these sections: - Setup health - one evidence-backed line for each review area. - Findings - only verified problems, ordered by impact, each with one fix. - Opportunities - optional improvements, clearly labeled optional. - Not verified - checks blocked by auth, network, runtime, or missing context. - Overall - healthy / improvements recommended / needs attention.
Do not emit an exhaustive placement inventory. Keep every bullet on one source line and let the terminal wrap it. For code evidence, use `[relative/path:line](/absolute/path:line)` so the terminal can link the file.
